unit: orthographic form (tokens from wordfreq's regex/UAX#29 tokenizer), case-folded; no lemmatisation
columns: word -> frequency (words grouped in Zipf-frequency bins rounded to 0.01)
licence: code: Apache-2.0; bundled data: CC BY-SA 4.0 (share-alike)
notes: NOT downloaded by this task: file shipped with wordfreq 3.1.1 already installed in the project venv ('large' = 'best' Polish list, 453320 entries; there is also small_pl.msgpack.gz). Per the package README, Polish is built from 6 source domains: Wikipedia, Subtitles (OPUS OpenSubtitles 2018; the SUBTLEX lists named in the README do not include SUBTLEX-PL), News (NewsCrawl 2014, GlobalVoices), Web (OSCAR), Twitter, Reddit; no Google Books for Polish. Sources are merged by dropping the highest and lowest per-word estimate and averaging the rest, so no corpus size applies. Verified 2026-11-13: wordfreq.word_frequency('fotosynteza','pl') = 1.74e-07.
